packageRules.description: Payload packages pin each other's exact version (e.g. @payloadcms/next peers payload@<same>); bumping one alone ships two copies of @payloadcms/ui and breaks /cms.
Supply-chain guard: hijacked npm releases are usually caught and unpublished within days, so wait 3 days before proposing a new version. Security fixes (vulnerabilityAlerts) are exempt.
